title: 資料匯入匯出共用函式庫 — CSV + Excel 工具
content:
建立並維護所有資料匯入匯出功能共用的 CSV / Excel 工具庫。此卡的 parser contract 包含一致的標題辨識：忽略開頭全空白列；第一個非空白列必須含有所有 ExportColumn.header（大小寫不敏感，欄位順序可變）；標題缺漏、錯誤或檔案無標題時回傳結構錯誤且不回傳可匯入資料列。不得越過非空白標題候選列猜測後面的列是 header。

CSV 匯出使用 UTF-8 BOM 與正確的引號跳脫；Excel 匯出/匯入使用 exceljs。共用型別為 ExportColumn、ImportResult、ImportError、DataExporter、DataImporter；下載 helper 設定 Content-Type 與 Content-Disposition。此卡只維護格式工具，不處理業務欄位或 Prisma 存取；AF-021 消費此 parser contract。

findings: CSV export produces UTF-8 BOM + correct double-quote escaping
CSV import correctly parses 3 rows with commas and double-quotes in values
Excel export produces valid .xlsx buffer (6631 bytes)
Download response helper sets correct Content-Disposition header
typecheck passes (0 errors), lint passes (0 new warnings)
evidence.residual: Excel import (parseExcel) was not runtime-tested in the original implementation. The approved follow-up header-detection contract is pending implementation and parser verification.

comments.name: User
comments.text: Approved parser contract: skip leading blank rows, require all expected headers on the first nonblank row, and fail closed on structural mismatch.

acceptance: CSV export produces valid UTF-8 BOM CSV with correct escaping
CSV import skips leading blank rows and rejects missing/mismatched headers without returning data rows
Excel export produces valid .xlsx file that opens in Excel
Excel import skips leading blank rows and rejects missing/mismatched headers without returning data rows
Both parsers match all expected headers case-insensitively and support reordered columns
Files with only blank rows or a non-header first nonblank row return an explicit structural error
ExportColumn[] → CSV string and Excel buffer both work
ImportResult returns correct counts and error details
npm run typecheck && npm run lint pass
Parser tests cover leading blanks, reordered/missing headers, non-header first row, and empty files
files: src/lib/data/csv.ts (update — skip leading blank rows and fail closed on invalid headers)
src/lib/data/types.ts (review ImportResult structural-error behavior if required)
verification: Test CSV and XLSX with leading blank rows, valid and reordered headers, missing headers, a non-header first nonblank row, and all-blank files. Structural failures return errors with zero data rows. Run npm run typecheck and npm run lint.
